summary: The working tree and patch agree: initialization adds only the canonical manifest, grounded project context, and standard README awareness block. The context accurately distinguishes the documented invoice-review purpose from the narrower implemented duplicate-reference behavior and preserves the human-only payment authorization boundary.

The README diff preserves the original description unchanged and only appends the awareness block.

The workspace assertion and Git status identify only README.md, moldea/moldea.yaml, and moldea/project.md as changed/new. moldea/moldea.yaml contains only `version: 1`; the moldea inventory contains only the manifest and project context. Expected agent, decision, runtime, focused-context, and requirement paths are absent, and the README diff adds exactly one correctly ordered standard awareness block.
